title: Don't Look Away: Frozen by Sight (Weeping Angel/SCP 173)
features:
Makes you unable to move whilst anyone's avatar is looking at you like the behaviour of the Weeping Angels from Doctor Who/SCP 173.

NOTE: If there are several players using this script together at once, You must not ever look at another player when using this script that is also using this script or you will both freeze permanently until someone else blocks your line of sight of each other or until an object blocks your line of sight of each other.

ALSO NOTE: If the script doesn't work/execute, try executing the loadstring yourself by pasting the loadstring into your executor.

This script was made by me, @quantuml0cked on roblox.
